bestBets.overview: MAJOR MAGNUS just has to repeat his last start effort to go very close in this. From gate 1 he should get every chance to breakthrough. SYLVA JACK has shown enough in his career to date to suggest he beats most of these on sheer ability alone. OBSCENTINO led to the shadows last start at this track and distance. Hard to charge into a 34 start maiden but if he repeats his last start he goes close. LONG SHANKS next best.

raceTips.comment: Not many winning hopes in the opener. Thinking it's a race in two between Major Magnus and Sylva Jack. Major Magnus worked nicely to the line last start when stretching out over 2000m. It was an improved effort and he should appreciate the extra 200m he sees here. Sylva Jack was fair over the mile but to me, it looks as if he wants more ground, which he gets. His form in better races this prep has been solid. Chef Commander is untried at the trip but given the stable are rising from 1300m to 2200m, they must believe he has some staying ability.

bestBets.overview: TEX 'N' CEE is a well bred type who makes debut on the back of a recent strong trial win. The blinkers go straight on and expecting a forward showing. PEAK TYCOON attacks this first-up with the benefit of two impressive trial efforts. SECOND DRAFT has trialled well for Team Williams. SPLINTABELLE has loooked sharp in her two 400m trials.

raceTips.comment: Start-speller Peak Tycoon is a promising filly who has impressed in a pair of trials.She led them up at Lark Hill and gripped on to win the heat. She debuted back in April and there was some merit in the run in what was a solid ity maiden. Stablemate Swing Dancer should be ready to do something on debut after two recent trials. She improved sharply into her second one. Chris Parnham is a positive booking. Tex 'n' Cee wears blinkers on debut after winning a Belmont trial. Generally a good sign he'll perform well in his first start.

bestBets.overview: GOD'S CHOICE has been back to the trials since her first-up run in late July. It looked a sharp effort and expecting her to run well. CARTIER GLOW was well supported on debut where she led but was gobbled up late but she was subsequently found to have jarred up. No surprise to see him improve sharply off that run. SALVE REGINA has shown enough in her career to date to beat most of these. KIAM'S CHOICE next best.

raceTips.comment: Thought God's Choice was one of the better bets of the day. She's short enough at even money, but really should be putting this field away with ease. The filly settled handy at Belmont last start before tiring quite late. Still wasn't beaten far there and then went to the trials and performed nicely. This isn't a strong race at all. Cartier Glow won a trial with ease before a sound on-pace effort first up. Fitter for it, he should be harder to catch.

bestBets.overview: MANTUA finds it hard to win as his record suggests however this race lacks depth and if he repeats his last start effort he goes close. CAWARRA rolls forward and gives a kick. BRINSON raced flat in his local debut. This looks a weaker race and no surprise to see him improve sharply on that effort. STATE OF FURY has claims.

raceTips.comment: The resuming So Immaculate was sound in a recent Belmont trial but always has to be respected when first up. She has won and placed in three fresh runs. Should settle midfield and be given every chance from the middle draw. Winter Bloom was outclassed in a strong 3YO race in town last start. I thought her two efforts prior were both very good. She possesses a bit of gate speed, so expect her to find the front from the good draw and light weight. Cawarra sat handy, stuck on well last start in the latest run of what has been a decent prep. Brinson best of the rest.

bestBets.overview: DON'T WINK is bursting to win a race after consecutive close up seconds. If she gets any luck from her wide draw she goes close. BLUE SPARX shook his maiden with a strong last start win. From an inside draw he gets a soft run and runs well again. GLORANARDO can go on with the job after breaking through at his last start. SILENT ARMADA next best.

raceTips.comment: Don't Wink has come back in good touch this prep with a pair of close-up 2nds. Given that recent form, this looks a nice race for him as the previous two races he contested were stronger affairs than this one. She'll be rocketing home and prove hard to hold out. Playing Free didn't fire a shot last start but his 2nd to Zeezea two back is decent form for this. Hello Veneta is a horse still on an upward spiral. She didn't see out the mile last start but is suited back to this trip. Last start winner Blue Sparx goes in next.

bestBets.overview: SAISOKU looks very close to breaking through after three consecutive close-up placings. He will roll forward and prove hard to rundown. FOREVER VICTORIOUS was narrowly edged last start after parking on the speed throughout. If she repeats that effort she goes close again. FLAVOURSOME dropped back in trip last start and found the strongly. RUTHLESS BOOM is racing well and has claims.

raceTips.comment: Pretty keen on Forever Victorious in this maiden over the mile. She went around big odds at Pinjarra and ran well, beating all bar a promising horse in Trickster, who I think would start $1.30 in a race like this. She's drawn well in barrier 2 so Clint Johnston-Porter will take her forward and should be able to lead for fun. Looks pretty hard to beat third up. Ruthless Bloom has been around the mark in all three starts this prep, including a 3rd here two back. The form out of that race was strengthened when the second-placed Tag Time won a subsequent maiden by nearly 10 lengths.

bestBets.overview: PURE MAC has run well in both starts this time in and should be peaking at his third run back from a spell. He rolls forward and is the one to rundown. CLASSIC IMPACT will appreciate the big drop in grade. She is another runner who will settle handy to the speed and run well. MILITARY JANE is in career best form and attacks this off a strong last start win. POINT ROCKS next best.

raceTips.comment: Pure Mac ticks a few boxes in this. There's been plenty to like about his two runs back from a spell so he comes here in good form. This is his preferred trip and he looks ready to win. He saluted when third up last time in. Gets some weight relief after the claim and has the early pace to settle in a prominent position. Capable Angel can mix her form but if she brings her best, she's a winning hope. She has drawn to enjoy a soft run. Sandfire Rose will improve over the mile. She's a two-time winner at this trip. Point Rocks next.
